summary: fractal-web starts the roster connection earlier, records perceived-UX traces, and closes page resources in a defined order.

compatibility.detail: No server protocol change. The app adopts one early roster socket and sends validated trace context.

manual.detail: No installation action required. Browser trace export is disabled unless VITE_OTLP_TRACES_URL is set at build time. Set it only when trace export is wanted.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change. Page teardown closes sockets before data source disposal.
